mechanism: Macro for {{discover}}(Path) + {{constraint}}(Latency ≈ 0). A high-speed discovery {{mode}} where critical filters ({{check}}) are temporarily disabled or delayed to maximize flow and serendipity. It prioritizes momentum and novelty over immediate correctness. Utilizes {{discover}}, {{explore_exploit}}, {{concept_blend}}, {{constraint}}.
failure_modes: Unfiltered output escapes sandbox and triggers irreversible external action.
Discovery produces incoherent results that waste downstream processing.
preconditions: Execution context is sandboxed (no irreversible external side-effects)
Output will be validated before acting on it
postconditions: Candidate ideas generated (unfiltered, require post-hoc validation)
